text: What if Czechia and Slovakia got back together?
They split in 1993, and nobody voted for it.
Poles said most people wanted to stay together, but two politicians agreed.
On New Year's Day, one country became two.
So what would this country get today?
About 16 million people, right in the heart of Europe.
Czechs drink more beer per person than anyone on Earth.
